title: Add --wait-for-expression for JS-predicate waits
description:
A caller waiting on a condition that is not a CSS selector or body text has to poll from outside. The mako2 employee-hours E2E suite polls the iframe's own window flag (_initIframePageDone, engine2.tpl's 'chrome rebuilt' signal) every 250ms via repeated eval, because --wait-for takes a selector and --wait-for-text takes body text; neither can express 'this JS expression is truthy'.

Shape would mirror the existing waits: --wait-for-expression '<js>' evaluated in the frame from --wait-for-frame/--frame, polled to --timeout, failing with the last value seen.

Deliberately deferred: the caller's poll loop works, this is convenience not a blocker, and it was raised while their suite was one green run from done. Pick it up deliberately rather than mid-flight.
close_reason: Implemented standalone and action-scoped JavaScript predicate waits in 1.12, including frame, file/stdin, async, and timeout last-value diagnostics.

title: Evaluate optional decision projections and bounded action providers
description: Inspect record/diff architecture; implement isolated deterministic projections, optional Jev adapter, semantic relocation/effect verification, and controlled synthetic browser evals. Report measured substrate results separately from unavailable real model results.
close_reason: Completed isolated provider experiment, deterministic safeguards/expansion, optional Jev wire adapter, semantic helpers, 396 paired real-Chrome mock runs and measured report. Credential-backed agent comparison and journal integration tracked separately in cdp-cli-d1p and cdp-cli-7li.

title: Deploy office GPU reranker with transcription-aware CDP projection
description: Assess office-pc GTX1080Ti shared transcription headroom, benchmark pinned Qwen3-Reranker0.6B Q8 CUDA sm61, deploy bounded LAN gateway and optional provider-neutral workflow configuration with deterministic fail-open evidence; verify local binary, source/runtime identity, negative admission and service lifecycle. Record peak transcription sharing and actual Mako2/WhiteTip2 end-to-end effectiveness limitations.

title: cdp-cli: daemon page-session 404s (logs/exec) should carry a structured code
description: Follow-up from wi-7235. daemon.ts sends {error:'Session not found'} (page session, not workspace session) as plain 404 so GET_CONSOLE_LOGS_FAILED has no details.cause.code. Emit a structured TARGET_NOT_FOUND-style error.

title: Design versioned semantic journal descriptors and effect witnesses
description: Current record stores argv and checks command delivery unless explicit state-click expectation is recorded. Experimental describeTarget/relocateTarget/resolveProposedTarget/verifyReplayEffect helpers demonstrate conservative stale-key relocation and transition checks. Design an actions/2 opt-in schema with masked parameters, stable frame/context descriptors, explicit from/to semantic effects, appeared/gone anchors, provenance and freshness. Live-test ambiguous rows, same-key replacement, same-session stale nodes, no-ops, pre-existing success, reload persistence and incomplete coverage before changing recording.

title: Run full Mako2 page-state A/B and tune capture cost
description: The seven-case synthetic pilot is too small to set a default Jarvis browser-QA policy. Replay 10 real Mako2 journeys and then 12 randomized clean/defect tasks across current snapshot flow, compact state diff, and one-call scripted state expectations. Measure accuracy, false pass/alarm, model input/output/cache, tool calls, screenshot views, wall time and cost for Luna, Sol and Sonnet. Investigate the cold SPA UNKNOWN and 1.8s default capture latency. Add retained-artifact expiry and optional visual/CSS evidence only where task accuracy requires it.
acceptance_criteria: Report matched-task results and confidence limits; no rise in false passes; evaluate whether >=30% median token or screenshot reduction holds on real Mako2 tasks before changing Jarvis defaults.

title: Add live cross-process session race contracts
description: Release 1.12 has unit contracts for named-session ownership, daemon leases, persistent store locking, context adoption, and removal ordering. Add a private-Chrome built-CLI subprocess suite that races two OS processes through create/adopt/action/remove, verifies lease conflict and no cross-owner access, and exercises stale-lock successor recovery end to end.
acceptance_criteria: A deterministic live test launches private Chrome and separate built CLI processes, proves ownership and lease enforcement during concurrent removal/action, and leaves no daemon, profile, context, or lock artifacts.

title: Automate npm publication or remove stale npm install guidance
description: npm still serves @auphansoftware/cdp-cli 1.5.2 while GitHub/S3 released 1.13.0. Add authenticated release automation or remove/update the npm installation path.

title: Run credential-backed Jev and Luna paired browser-agent evaluations
description: The decision experiment measures deterministic safety and mock projection tradeoffs only. No Jev key was available through project/environment secret mechanisms. Use evals/decision opt-in Jev runner, then controlled Luna/Sol agent runs on held-out realistic journeys: equal batching/capture/prompts, three randomized repeats, total provider plus downstream tokens/cost/latency, expansions/retries, false-negative evidence, semantic replay effects and escalation stage frequencies. Calibrate confidence/margin on held-out cases. Link existing cdp-cli-7sz and cdp-cli-uck; do not ship learned filtering defaults from mock results.
notes: Temporary Jev credential supplied by user; real paired region/bounded-action trials and actual Codex Luna bounded fixture selector completed on 2026-10-03. CPU comparison isolated office CT107. Multi-step agent loop, calibrated visual routing, actual expansion traces and account-priced cost remain cdp-cli-ozz; fixture outcomes are not full browser-agent completion.

title: Define page-state capture privacy and expiry policy
description: Prototype masks form/editable values but persists visible labels and text in state JSON, and capture count is bounded per page without age expiry. Define an allowlist/redaction profile for customer/payment surfaces, a time-to-live cleanup path, and explicit storage policy before broad Jarvis deployment. Include same-origin frame and open-shadow content.
acceptance_criteria: No raw test PII survives in capture files under the chosen profile; age-limited cleanup and permissions work on Windows; coverage flags redacted regions so assertions cannot falsely pass.

title: Extend action replay to out-of-process frames and harden journal lifecycle
description: Action recording currently supports main and same-origin frame verbs. Add portable mapping from a stable iframe selector to an exact OOPIF target for target-* actions, and add bounded stale-lock recovery plus retention for opt-in journals. Keep replay fail-closed on ambiguous/missing frames. Cover with live Chrome and Jarvis browser-qa-run contracts.

title: Add exact OOPIF pointer operations
description: Release 1.12 adds exact target discovery, query, fill, eval, and keyboard routing for OOPIF hosted fields, but intentionally omits mouse-coordinate dispatch because child-local coordinates cannot be assumed to map safely to the root viewport. Design and verify an exact iframe-to-root coordinate transform and delivery witness in a real site-isolated browser before exposing target-click/drag.
acceptance_criteria: A built-CLI live test clicks an element in a forced OOPIF, proves the intended child event target received it, proves a same-selector parent decoy did not, covers transformed/scrolled frames, and fails closed when coordinates cannot be mapped.

title: Recover page-state store locks safely after a crashed writer
description: StateStore uses an exclusive lock file to preserve capture sequence and aliases across processes. A crashed writer can leave the file and future commands return STATE_STORE_BUSY after five seconds. Add owner PID/creation metadata and a race-safe stale recovery or OS lock strategy; never unlink a live writer's lock by age alone.
acceptance_criteria: Live process is never preempted; killed writer recovers automatically; concurrent save/list/remove retains consistent index and aliases on Windows.

title: Evaluate multi-step real-browser local/Jev/Decisions routing and calibrated vision
description: Follow CPU CT107 fixture experiments with actual multi-step browser-agent observe/expand/escalation traces, task-relevant independent gold beyond must-keeps, screenshot candidate permutations and small-text/stale/injection cases, calibrated local visual scores, optional ShowUI grounding. Obtain exact OpenAI Decisions contract/account access; never substitute Responses silently. Measure total downstream billed tokens and end-to-end dollars per successful task; current Codex Luna comparison has subscription usage only.
notes: 2.2.0 deterministic no-model production workflow now implemented: action + fresh protected state/diff/diagnostic errors, canonical expansion and owned-session stdio MCP PNG blocks. CLI/MCP source guards, masked select values and recovery without blind retries verified on private Chrome. Updated core workflow skill, central Jarvis QA/worker/investigation prompts and plugin agent guidance. GPU remains optional experimental; follow-up still paired real Mako2/WhiteTip2 effectiveness, iframe/mobile/negative controls, calibrated model execution and Decisions access.

title: Add action-scoped console and network evidence to page-state diffs
description: The first page-state prototype captures rendered text and controls only. Add bounded console-error and network-request/response summaries between before/after captures, with action attribution, privacy-safe URL/header handling, and UNKNOWN when the window is unavailable. Keep the default diff compact and exercise daemon/no-daemon modes.
acceptance_criteria: Live fixture proves an action-caused console error and failed request are reported once; unrelated earlier events are excluded; coverage flags failed/unavailable journals.

title: Align documented coverage target with configured coverage report
description: v1.13.0 coverage execution reports about 50% overall lines while README/AGENTS claim 80%+. Enforce the target or document the actual scope/threshold.

title: cdp-cli: daemon health should expose cdpUrl so the client can cross-check an explicit CDP_DAEMON_URL
description: Follow-up from wi-7235. Explicit-but-wrong CDP_DAEMON_URL is still trusted; add cdpUrl/browser identity to /health and compare client-side. Also TARGET_NOT_FOUND when page absent from that Chrome, and unify index.ts outputThrownError with outputCommandError.

title: Raise executable coverage gate to 80 percent
description: Vitest 4 coverage had been broken because the config used the removed c8 provider and ignored top-level threshold fields. Release 1.12 repairs coverage with @vitest/coverage-v8 and establishes an enforced non-regression floor (45 lines/functions/statements, 40 branches). Current full unit coverage is about 48% lines and 50% functions because large legacy CLI modules have little direct coverage; add focused tests and raise the enforced thresholds to the repository guideline.
acceptance_criteria: npm run test:coverage passes with thresholds of at least 80% lines/functions/statements and 75% branches; no production modules are excluded solely to inflate the result.
